answers.why: The assembled kings come to fight Israel, Joshua's people.
God promises Joshua to deliver the enemy slain before Israel's army.
Israel defeats and pursues the enemies with plural verbs.
Israel is the conquering force that leaves the cities unburned except Hazor.
The cities come against Israel in battle during Joshua's conquest.
Joshua gives Israel land according to their divisions and tribes.
Moses gives the territory to the half tribe of Manasseh.
Joshua is commanded to allot the land to Israel as an inheritance.
The half tribe of Manasseh receives land alongside the nine tribes.
The Geshurites and Maachathites dwell among Israel until the narrator's day.
The God of Israel provides the Levite tribe's inheritance through sacrifices.
Manasseh is named as Machir's father in 'Machir the son of Manasseh.'
The LORD God of Israel is the Levite tribe's inheritance.
